title: Baked cauliflower cheese pasta
instructions: Parboil the wholemeal pasta for 6 minutes. Blanch the cauliflower florets for 5 minutes.
Stir the milk with the mustard, nutmeg, salt, pepper and half of the mountain cheese into a sauce, then fold in the pasta and cauliflower.
Transfer to a baking dish, scatter the remaining cheese on top and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes until golden.

title: One-pot minestrone with spelt and pesto
instructions: Precook the spelt in the vegetable stock for 10 minutes.
Cut the savoy cabbage, parsnip and celery into pieces, add them with the passata and white beans and simmer for 15 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Stir in the pesto and parsley and serve in a deep plate.

title: Family vegetable bake with a cottage-cheese topping and herbs
instructions: Cut the courgette, carrot, broccoli and pepper into chunks and toss them in a baking dish with the olive oil and thyme.
Par-roast at 200 °C for 20 minutes.
Stir the cottage cheese with the parsley, spread it on the vegetables as a topping and bake for a further 8 minutes until the topping sets.

title: Kimchi gyoza with chicken filling and a sesame dip
instructions: Mix the minced chicken with the finely chopped kimchi and half of the spring onion greens. Shape the small amount of wonton wrapper into 2 open gyoza and set the filling on top.
Fry in 1 g of the sesame oil for 4 minutes, add 2 tbsp water and steam covered for 3 minutes. Cook the edamame for 4 minutes.
Stir the soy sauce, remaining sesame oil and sesame seeds into a dip. Serve the gyoza with the edamame, cucumber sticks, dip and remaining spring onion greens.

title: Pho ga (Vietnamese chicken rice-noodle soup) with herbs
instructions: Simmer the beef stock with the ginger and spring onion for 15 minutes, poach the chicken breast in it for 10 minutes, lift it out and slice it into strips.
Soak the rice noodles in the hot broth for 4 minutes. Cook the pak choi in it for 2 minutes.
Serve in a deep bowl and finish with the fish sauce, lime, coriander and mint.

title: Bun thit nuong ga (grilled chicken on rice noodles with herbs and nuoc cham)
instructions: Marinate the chicken breast with 3 g of the rapeseed oil, a little fish sauce and lime for 20 minutes, then grill or fry for 8 minutes and slice into strips.
Soak the rice noodles in hot water for 4 minutes, then cool. Cut the carrot into batons and the cucumber into slices.

Stir the remaining fish sauce with the remaining lime and 1 tbsp water into a nuoc cham. Arrange a small amount of noodles with the salad, vegetables, sprouts, herbs and chicken, and spoon over the dip.

title: Banh xeo with prawns, mung beans and herb salad
instructions: Soak the mung beans in hot water for 10 minutes and drain. Stir the rice flour with the light coconut milk and 4 tbsp water into a thin batter.
Pour the batter into 4 g of the rapeseed oil to make 1 large thin pancake, scatter the prawns, mung beans and spring onion on one half, cook for 4 minutes and fold it over.
Serve with the salad, mint, coriander and lime.

title: Laab hed (mushroom larb) with sticky rice and cucumber
instructions: Soak the sticky rice in water for 20 minutes, then steam it for 12 minutes.
Finely chop the mushrooms and tempeh and fry them in the rapeseed oil for 8 minutes, then toss with the soy sauce, lime, spring onion, mint and coriander into a larb mixture.
Serve with cucumber slices and the sticky rice.

title: Pad krapow gai with minced chicken, a fried egg and leaf salad
instructions: Finely chop the garlic and chilli, fry them in the rapeseed oil for 30 seconds, then fry the minced chicken for 6 minutes until crumbly.
Fold in the soy sauce and Thai basil and let it heat for 1 minute.
Fry an egg in the same pan and serve the mince with the egg and the leaf salad.

title: Tom yum goong with prawns, mushrooms and rice
instructions: Cook the parboiled rice in 80 ml water for 12 minutes.
Simmer the vegetable stock with the lemongrass and chilli for 8 minutes, then cook the mushrooms and prawns in it for 4 minutes.
Finish with the fish sauce, lime and coriander and serve with the rice.

title: Agedashi tofu with daikon, rice and spring onion greens
instructions: Cook the parboiled rice in 80 ml water for 12 minutes. Press the tofu, cut it into cubes, coat in the rice flour and fry in the rapeseed oil for 6 minutes until golden.
Finely grate the daikon. Dilute the soy sauce with 4 tbsp hot water.
Serve the tofu in a deep plate with the sauce, grated daikon, spring onion greens and the rice.

title: Yakitori chicken with broccoli and sesame rice
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 90 ml salted water for 12 minutes, leave to stand covered for 5 minutes and mix with half of the sesame seeds.
Cut the chicken breast into 8 cubes, marinate with the soy sauce, sesame oil, grated ginger and the chilli and thread onto two skewers.
Grill the skewers under a hot grill or in a grill pan for 8 minutes, turning, until glossy brown.
Divide the broccoli into florets and steam for 5 minutes. Serve with the sesame rice and the skewers, and scatter over the remaining sesame and the spring onion.

title: Doenjang jjigae with tofu, courgette and brown rice
instructions: Simmer the brown rice in 30 ml water for 25 minutes until soft and leave to stand covered.
Sweat the onion and garlic in the sesame oil in a pot for 2 minutes. Stir the doenjang into the vegetable stock and pour it in.
Cut the courgette into half-moons, slice the shiitake and cut the pak choi into pieces, add them to the broth and simmer for 8 minutes.
Dice the tofu, heat it in the soup for 3 minutes and serve in a deep bowl with the small portion of brown rice.

title: Jiachang tofu with peppers and rice
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 80 ml salted water for 12 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes, pat dry and fry in the rapeseed oil for 6 minutes until golden, then lift out.
Cut the pepper into strips, finely chop the garlic and ginger and fry in the pan juices for 3 minutes. Pour in the soy sauce.
Return the tofu, toss until glossy for 2 minutes, scatter with spring onion and serve with the rice.

title: Dan dan noodles with minced turkey, sesame and cucumber
instructions: Cook the wholemeal noodles in salted water for 8 minutes until al dente, reserve 2 tbsp of the cooking water and drain.
Fry the minced turkey with the chopped garlic and chilli in a pan without extra fat for 6 minutes until crumbly, deglaze with half of the soy sauce.
Stir the tahini with the remaining soy sauce, the noodle water and the sesame seeds into a creamy sauce.
Toss the noodles with the sesame sauce and the mince, and serve with cucumber matchsticks and spring onion.

title: Wonton soup with prawn and chicken dumplings and pak choi
instructions: Chop the prawns and chicken breast very finely and mix with half of the grated ginger, 4 ml of the soy sauce and 1 g of the sesame oil.
Divide the wonton wrappers into 8 sheets, place a teaspoon of filling on each, close into dumplings and press the edges firmly.
Bring the vegetable stock to the boil with the remaining ginger and poach the wontons in it for 4 minutes. Add the pak choi in pieces and cook for 2 more minutes.
Season with the remaining soy sauce and sesame oil, serve in a deep bowl and scatter with spring onion.

title: Hainanese chicken with rice, cucumber and ginger-spring onion oil
instructions: Poach the chicken breast in lightly boiling salted water with half of the ginger for 15 minutes, rest in the broth for 5 minutes, lift out and slice.
Simmer the parboiled rice in 90 ml of the chicken broth for 12 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Finely chop the remaining ginger and the spring onion, and heat with the sesame oil in a small pan for 1 minute until fragrant.
Plate the rice and the sliced cucumber, lay the chicken on top, drizzle with the ginger-spring onion oil and the lime juice and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

title: Nasi lemak light with baked mackerel, cucumber and peanuts
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice with the coconut milk and 50 ml water for 12 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Rub the mackerel with the lime juice and a pinch of salt, brush with the rapeseed oil and bake at 200 °C for 12 minutes.
Slice the cucumber and roughly chop the peanuts.
Plate the coconut rice and set the baked mackerel, cucumber, peanuts and the sambal alongside, finishing with lime.

title: Javanese soto ayam with rice and sambal
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 80 ml salted water for 12 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Finely dice the onion and ginger, sweat them in a pot without extra fat for 3 minutes and dust with turmeric and pepper.
Pour in the meat stock, add the chicken breast and poach for 15 minutes. Lift out, shred and taste the broth.
Put the rice and chicken in a deep bowl, pour over the golden broth and top with the bean sprouts, coriander, lime juice and sambal.

title: Chicken adobo with rice and steamed vegetables
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 90 ml salted water for 12 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Cut the chicken breast into 4 pieces and brown in the rapeseed oil for 4 minutes. Add the garlic, deglaze with the soy sauce and apple cider vinegar, and add the bay leaf and pepper.
Braise covered for 15 minutes until the sauce is glossy and reduced.
Steam the broccoli and green beans for 5 minutes and serve with the adobo and the rice.

title: Sinigang na isda, sour tamarind fish soup with vegetables and rice
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 80 ml salted water for 12 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Sweat the onion in a pot for 2 minutes, pour in the water, stir in the tamarind and bring to the boil.
Quarter the tomato, cut the green beans and daikon into pieces and simmer in the sour broth for 8 minutes.
Add the tilapia in 3 pieces, poach in the broth for 6 minutes, finish with the lime juice and serve with the rice.

title: Kimbap with tuna, egg, spinach and pickled radish
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 100 ml salted water for 12 minutes, rest for 5 minutes, mix with the rice vinegar and 2 g of the sesame oil and leave to cool.
Fry the egg into a thin omelette and cut into strips. Wilt the spinach briefly, squeeze it out and mix with 1 g of sesame oil. Cut the cucumber and radish into long strips.
Loosen the tuna with the remaining sesame oil. Cover the nori sheet with the rice, lay the tuna, egg, spinach, cucumber and radish in a line and roll up tightly.
Cut the roll into 8 slices and serve immediately.

title: Samgyetang, ginseng chicken rice soup with garlic and jujubes
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into 3 pieces. Slice the ginseng root and leave the garlic cloves whole.
Bring the water to the boil with the ginseng, garlic, jujubes and the parboiled rice, add the chicken and simmer gently for 25 minutes.
Season with the salt and sesame oil.
Serve in a deep bowl and scatter with spring onion. Leave the softened jujubes and the ginseng slices visible.

title: Kongnamul-bap, soybean sprout rice with tofu and egg
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 90 ml salted water for 12 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Blanch the soybean sprouts for 3 minutes and drain. Dice the tofu and fry in 3 g of the sesame oil for 4 minutes until golden.
Fry the egg in 1 g of sesame oil as a fried egg. Loosely mix the rice with the soybean sprouts, the remaining sesame oil and the soy sauce.
Serve in a bowl, top with the tofu and the fried egg, and sprinkle with sesame seeds and spring onion.

title: Chirashi bowl with salmon, avocado and pickled cucumber
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 90 ml salted water for 12 minutes, rest for 5 minutes, mix with the rice vinegar and leave to cool until lukewarm.
Slice the cucumber thinly, marinate with a pinch of salt for 5 minutes and drain. Slice the avocado.
Cut the salmon into 2 cm cubes and sear in a hot pan without fat for 30 seconds per side on the outside only, leaving the inside pink.
Put the rice in a bowl, arrange the salmon, avocado and cucumber on top, scatter nori strips and sesame seeds, and serve the soy sauce alongside.

title: Baked pollock with carrots, courgette and mashed potato
instructions: Peel the potatoes, cut into pieces and boil in salted water for 20 minutes until soft, drain and mash with 3 g of the rapeseed oil and half of the chives.
Cut the carrot and courgette into batons, toss with 3 g of rapeseed oil, salt and the lemon juice and roast on a tray at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Brush the pollock with the remaining rapeseed oil and salt, place it on the vegetables and cook for 10 more minutes until white and firm.
Serve with the mashed potato and scatter with the remaining chives.

title: Soba salad with smoked tofu, cucumber and nori
instructions: Cook the soba noodles in boiling water for 5 minutes, rinse under cold water and drain.
Cut the smoked tofu into strips and fry in 2 g of the sesame oil for 3 minutes. Cut the cucumber into half-moons and the spring onion into rings.
Stir the soy sauce with the remaining sesame oil into a dressing.
Toss the noodles, tofu and cucumber with the dressing and serve with nori strips, sesame seeds and spring onion.

title: Kitsune udon with tofu, spinach and spring onion greens
instructions: Cook the udon noodles according to the pack instructions for 8 minutes and drain.
Cut the tofu into 1 cm slices and fry in 2 g of the sesame oil for 4 minutes per side until golden.
Heat the vegetable stock with the soy sauce and the remaining sesame oil, and wilt the spinach in it for 1 minute.
Put the udon in a deep bowl, pour over the broth, top with the tofu and spinach and scatter with spring onion greens.

title: Sesame chicken with pak choi and shiitake from the pan
instructions: Cut the chicken thigh into 3 cm pieces, marinate with 10 g of the sesame oil and the soy sauce for 5 minutes, then roll in half of the remaining sesame seeds.
Fry the pieces in 10 g of sesame oil for 8 minutes until golden and cooked through, then lift out.
Quarter the pak choi, slice the shiitake and fry in the remaining sesame oil for 4 minutes.
Place the chicken on the vegetables and sprinkle with the remaining sesame seeds.

title: Mì Quảng with prawns, chicken and rice noodles
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in hot water for 6 minutes, drain and set aside.
Cut the chicken breast into strips and fry in the rapeseed oil for 5 minutes, add the prawns and cook for 3 more minutes until pink.
Deglaze with the fish sauce and lime juice and toss briefly.
Put the noodles in a bowl, top with the chicken and prawns, and scatter with peanuts, spring onion and coriander.

title: Salmon and sesame skewers with asparagus and lime
instructions: Cut the salmon into 8 cubes, marinate with 4 g of the rapeseed oil, half of the lime juice, dill and pepper, roll in the sesame seeds and thread onto two skewers.
Snap off the woody ends of the asparagus and toss with the remaining rapeseed oil and lime juice.
Cook the skewers and asparagus in a grill pan or under the grill for 6 minutes, turning once, until the sesame is golden and the asparagus is tender-crisp.
Serve immediately with a piece of lime.

title: Sea bass tiradito with aji amarillo sauce and sweet potato
instructions: Peel the sweet potato, cut into 1 cm slices and steam for 12 minutes until soft.
Blend the aji amarillo paste with the olive oil, half of the lime juice and half of the coriander into a smooth yellow sauce.
Slice the sea bass very thinly, fan it out on a cold plate and marinate with the remaining lime juice for 3 minutes until the surface turns opaque.
Drizzle the aji sauce over the fish and arrange thin red onion rings, the remaining coriander and the sweet potato slices alongside.

title: Chicken tacos with pineapple salsa, red cabbage and lime
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into strips, fry with 3 g of the rapeseed oil and the chilli in a pan for 8 minutes, and deglaze with half of the lime juice.
Dice the pineapple and onion and mix with the coriander and remaining lime juice into a salsa. Cut the red cabbage into fine strips.
Warm the corn tortillas in 1 g of rapeseed oil for 30 seconds per side.
Fill the tortillas with the chicken, red cabbage and pineapple salsa and serve immediately.

title: Baja fish tacos with cabbage slaw and yoghurt-lime sauce
instructions: Cut the pollock into 4 strips, season with 3 g of the rapeseed oil and the chilli and fry in a pan for 3 minutes per side until white and firm.
Shred the white cabbage finely and mix with half of the lime juice and the coriander. Stir the yoghurt with the remaining lime juice into a sauce.
Warm the corn tortillas briefly in 3 g of rapeseed oil.
Fill the tortillas with the fish, the slaw and the yoghurt-lime sauce.

title: Tuna tostadas with cucumber, radish and coriander
instructions: Brush the corn tortillas with 2 g of the olive oil and bake in a pan or the oven for 4 minutes until crisp and firm as tostadas.
Loosen the tuna with 2 g of olive oil and half of the lime juice. Slice the cucumber and radishes thinly and cut the red onion into fine rings.
Spread the tuna on the tostadas and arrange the cucumber, radishes and onion on top.
Drizzle with coriander, the remaining olive oil and lime juice and serve immediately while crisp.

title: Enchiladas verdes with chicken, salsa verde and salad
instructions: Poach the chicken breast in salted water for 15 minutes, lift out and shred.
Simmer the tomatillos, onion, chilli and garlic for 10 minutes until soft, then blend with the coriander and 2 tbsp water into a green salsa.
Warm the corn tortillas briefly in the rapeseed oil, fill with the chicken, roll, place in a small dish and bake with the salsa and yoghurt: 8 minutes at 200 °C.
Serve with the leaf salad beside the dish.

title: Oven chiles rellenos with bean filling and tomato sauce
instructions: Halve the peppers lengthways, deseed them and pre-roast at 220 °C for 8 minutes until the skin blisters.
Sweat the onion and garlic in 4 g of the rapeseed oil, mash the tofu, add the black beans and cumin and fry for 5 minutes.
Fill the peppers with the bean and tofu mixture. Reduce the passata with the remaining rapeseed oil for 5 minutes and pour it over the peppers.
Bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes until the filling is hot.

title: Yucatán lime and chicken soup with tortilla strips
instructions: Cut the corn tortillas into thin strips and fry in the rapeseed oil for 3 minutes until crisp, then drain on kitchen paper.
Sweat the onion and pepper in a pot for 3 minutes, dice the tomato and cook for 2 more minutes. Pour in the vegetable stock.
Add the chicken breast and poach for 15 minutes, lift out, shred and return it to the broth.
Finish with the lime juice and coriander, serve in a deep bowl and add the tortilla strips only just before eating.

title: Chicken tamal with tomato salsa and salad
instructions: Mix the cornmeal with 6 g of the rapeseed oil and the vegetable stock into a soft masa dough and leave to swell for 5 minutes.
Fry the chicken breast in 2 g of rapeseed oil for 8 minutes, cut into small cubes and mix with half of the diced onion.
Spread the dough into two rectangles on cling film, fill with the chicken, roll into tamales and wrap tightly. Steam over boiling water for 20 minutes.
Mix the tomato and remaining onion with the coriander into a salsa. Unwrap the tamales and serve with the salsa and leaf salad.

title: Tikin xic, Yucatecan achiote fish with rice, tomato and red onion
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 80 ml salted water for 12 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Stir the achiote, oregano, cumin and garlic with 10 ml of the lime juice and 4 g of the rapeseed oil into a paste. Rub it over the cod and leave to stand for 10 minutes.
Wrap the fish in a banana leaf or baking paper, top with tomato slices and bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes until firm and opaque.
Cut the red onion into fine rings and mix with the remaining lime juice, the coriander and 3 g of rapeseed oil. Open the leaf and serve the fish with the rice and the onion.

title: Bobó de camarão, prawns in cassava-coconut sauce with rice
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 80 ml salted water for 12 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Peel and dice the cassava, boil in salted water for 15 minutes until soft, drain and blend smooth with the coconut milk.
Sweat the onion, garlic and pepper in 4 g of the rapeseed oil for 4 minutes, add the prawns and fry for 3 minutes until pink.
Stir in the cassava-coconut purée and the remaining rapeseed oil, heat until creamy for 3 minutes, finish with lime juice and coriander and serve with the rice.

title: Chicken milanesa with chimichurri and tomato salad
instructions: Flatten the chicken breast, salt it and coat in the beaten egg and wholemeal flour.
Fry in the rapeseed oil for 4 minutes per side until golden.
Finely chop the parsley and garlic and mix with 6 g of the olive oil and the red wine vinegar into a chimichurri. Slice the tomato and mix with the remaining olive oil into a salad.
Serve the milanesa with the chimichurri and the tomato salad.

title: Baked beef empanadas with chimichurri and salad
instructions: Knead the wholemeal flour with 4 g of the olive oil, the egg and 2 tbsp cold water into a dough and rest for 10 minutes.
Fry the minced beef with the onion, pepper, garlic and chilli in 2 g of olive oil for 8 minutes until crumbly, then leave to cool.
Roll the dough into 4 circles, fill, close into half-moons, press the edges and bake at 200 °C for 18 minutes until golden.
Stir the parsley with the remaining olive oil and apple cider vinegar into a chimichurri. Serve the empanadas with the chimichurri and leaf salad.

title: Andean locro, pumpkin, corn and bean stew with quinoa
instructions: Rinse the quinoa in a sieve and simmer in 140 ml salted water for 15 minutes, then leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Sweat the onion and garlic in the rapeseed oil for 3 minutes, dice the pumpkin and cook for 5 more minutes.
Add the black beans, corn, cumin and 150 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes until the pumpkin breaks down and the stew is creamy.
Finish with coriander and serve with the quinoa in a deep bowl.

title: Ropa vieja with peppers, olives and brown rice
instructions: Simmer the brown rice in 120 ml salted water for 25 minutes and leave to stand covered.
Cut the beef into 2 pieces and brown in the rapeseed oil for 5 minutes. Add the onion, garlic and pepper strips and sweat for 4 minutes.
Add the passata, olives, cumin and paprika, pour in 150 ml water and braise covered for 40 minutes until the beef is tender.
Shred the beef in the sauce with two forks and serve with the brown rice.

title: Arroz con pollo with peas, pimientos and lime
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into 4 pieces and brown in the rapeseed oil for 5 minutes, then lift out.
Sweat the onion, garlic and pepper in the pan juices for 3 minutes, add the parboiled rice and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the vegetable stock, return the chicken, and simmer covered for 15 minutes. Stir in the peas and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Finish with the lime juice and coriander and serve hot.

title: Sancocho de pollo with cassava, corn and coriander
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into 3 pieces and brown in the rapeseed oil for 4 minutes.
Dice the onion, slice the carrot and cut the cassava into 3 cm pieces, add them to the meat and cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock, add the corn and simmer for 25 minutes until the cassava and chicken are tender.
Finish with coriander and serve in a deep bowl.

title: Black bean soup with orange, cumin and avocado
instructions: Sweat the onion and garlic in the rapeseed oil for 3 minutes and toast the cumin briefly with them.
Add the black beans and vegetable stock and simmer for 12 minutes. Blend half of the soup and stir it back in so it is creamy but still chunky.
Segment the orange, catch the juice and stir it into the soup, and season with pepper.
Slice the avocado, lay it on the soup and serve with coriander and the orange segments.

title: Quinoa chaufa with chicken, vegetables and sesame
instructions: Rinse the quinoa and simmer in 100 ml salted water for 15 minutes, rest for 5 minutes and fluff.
Cut the chicken breast into small cubes and fry in 4 g of the rapeseed oil for 5 minutes, then lift out.
Fry the pepper, carrot and garlic in the remaining 2 g of oil for 3 minutes, add the quinoa and chicken and stir-fry hard with the soy sauce.
Fold in the spring onion and sesame seeds and serve immediately.

title: Andean humita, corn bake with egg and tomato salad
instructions: Roughly blend half of the corn with 2 tbsp water and leave the remaining kernels whole.
Sweat the onion and garlic in 3 g of the olive oil for 3 minutes, add both parts of the corn and the beaten egg, simmer until creamy for 5 minutes and season with half of the herbs.
Put the mixture into a small ovenproof dish and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes until the surface is golden and set. Do not use cheese.
Slice the tomato and cut the pepper into strips, mix with the remaining olive oil, lemon juice and remaining herbs into a salad and serve with the humita.

title: Xinxim de galinha with cashews, light coconut milk and rice
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 90 ml salted water for 12 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Roughly chop the cashews. Cut the chicken breast into 4 pieces and brown in the rapeseed oil for 4 minutes, then add the onion.
Add the coconut milk, cashews and pepper and braise until creamy for 12 minutes. Fold in the spinach until it wilts.
Finish with the lime juice and serve with the rice.

title: Açaí bowl with banana, granola and roasted peanuts
instructions: Stir the unsweetened açaí purée with the skyr until smooth and creamy and violet. Spoon into a bowl.
Slice the banana and rinse the blueberries. Toast the oats in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden.
Arrange the banana, berries, toasted oats and peanuts on the açaí cream and serve immediately.

title: Bandeja bowl with beef strips, beans, rice, egg and avocado
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 60 ml salted water for 12 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes. Heat the kidney beans in a pan for 5 minutes.
Cut the beef steak into strips, fry hard with 3 g of the rapeseed oil and the onion for 4 minutes, leaving the centre pink, then rest.
Fry the egg in 2 g of rapeseed oil as a fried egg. Slice the avocado and tomato.
Arrange the rice, beans, beef strips, fried egg, avocado and tomato side by side in a bowl.

title: Caldo de pollo with vegetables, lime and coriander
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into 3 pieces, bring to the boil in the vegetable stock and poach gently for 15 minutes, skimming any foam.
Dice the potatoes and carrot, cut the courgette into half-moons and the onion into large pieces, add them to the broth and simmer for 15 minutes until everything is tender.
Shred the chicken and return it to the soup.
Finish with the lime juice and coriander and serve in a deep bowl.

title: Prawn tacos with cabbage-mango slaw and chilli-lime
instructions: Fry the prawns with 3 g of the rapeseed oil and the chilli in a pan for 4 minutes until pink, and deglaze with half of the lime juice.
Shred the white cabbage finely, dice the mango and avocado, cut the red onion into fine rings and mix with the coriander and remaining lime juice.
Warm the corn tortillas briefly in 3 g of rapeseed oil.
Fill the tortillas with the prawns and the cabbage-mango slaw and serve immediately.

title: Bogotá ajiaco chicken and potato soup with corn and capers
instructions: Poach the chicken breast in the vegetable stock for 15 minutes, lift out and shred.
Dice the potatoes, chop the onion and simmer in the broth for 15 minutes until the potatoes partly break down and the soup turns creamy.
Add the corn cob pieces and the chicken and cook for 8 more minutes.
Stir in the capers and coriander and serve in a deep bowl.

title: Ethiopian doro wat with injera and cabbage
instructions: Stir the teff with 80 ml water into a thin batter and rest for 10 minutes. Cook 2 thin injera flatbreads in a non-stick pan without fat, 2 minutes each, until the surface is bubbly.
Sweat the onion without fat for 8 minutes until dark, add the garlic and berbere spice, then pour in the passata and 80 ml water.
Cut the chicken thigh into 3 pieces, brown in the rapeseed oil for 4 minutes, add to the sauce and braise for 20 minutes. Hard-boil the egg, peel it and cook in the sauce for 5 minutes.
Steam the white cabbage in strips for 5 minutes. Serve the doro wat with the egg, injera and cabbage.

title: Ethiopian beef tibs with kale and carrots
instructions: Cut the beef steak into 2 cm cubes, and marinate with 4 g of the olive oil, the chilli, garlic and rosemary for 5 minutes.
Sear the meat in a very hot pan for 4 minutes, leaving the centre pink, then lift out.
Slice the carrot, cut the kale into strips and the onion into wedges, and fry in the remaining olive oil for 6 minutes until tender-crisp.
Return the beef, toss for 1 minute and serve immediately.

title: Waakye, rice and beans with egg, tomato relish and cucumber
instructions: Boil the black-eyed beans in plenty of water for 35 minutes until soft, drain and reserve 50 ml of the cooking water.
Add the parboiled rice and the reserved cooking water to the beans, top up with a little water if needed, simmer together for 12 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Hard-boil the egg and halve it. Dice the tomato and onion and mix with the chilli and 3 g of the rapeseed oil into a relish. Slice the cucumber.
Fluff the waakye with the remaining rapeseed oil and serve with the egg, tomato relish and cucumber.

title: Poulet yassa with onions, lemon and rice
instructions: Marinate the chicken breast with half of the lemon juice, 4 g of the olive oil and the garlic for 15 minutes. Slice the onion into rings.
Simmer the parboiled rice in 60 ml salted water for 12 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Brown the chicken in the remaining olive oil for 5 minutes, then lift out. Sweat the onion rings for 10 minutes until golden, and add the remaining lemon juice and the olives.
Return the chicken, braise in the onion sauce for 8 minutes and serve with parsley and the rice.

title: Egusi soup with chicken, leaf spinach and rice
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 60 ml salted water for 12 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes. Simmer the lentils in 80 ml water for 15 minutes until soft.
Dice the chicken breast and brown in the rapeseed oil for 5 minutes, then add the onion.
Stir the egusi with 4 tbsp water into a thick paste, add it to the chicken, lentils, passata and vegetable stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Fold in the spinach, wilt for 3 minutes and serve with the rice.

title: Peanut stew with chicken, sweet potato and rice
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 60 ml salted water for 12 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Dice the chicken breast and brown it without extra fat for 4 minutes, then add the onion. Dice the sweet potato and cook for 3 more minutes.
Stir the peanut butter smooth with the passata and vegetable stock, pour it in and simmer for 15 minutes until the sweet potato is soft.
Fold in the spinach and serve with the rice.

title: Sukuma wiki with beef and ugali
instructions: Cut the beef into small cubes and brown in the rapeseed oil for 6 minutes, then add the onion.
Dice the tomato, cut the kale into strips, add them to the meat, pour in 100 ml water and stew for 15 minutes until the kale is soft. Season with salt and pepper.
Bring 250 ml water to the boil, rain in the maize meal while stirring constantly and cook for 8 minutes into a firm ugali porridge, then shape into a loaf.
Serve the sukuma wiki with a piece of ugali.

title: Nyama choma, grilled beef with kachumbari and ugali
instructions: Rub the beef steak with 3 g of the rapeseed oil, salt and pepper and leave at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Grill the steak on a hot grill or in a grill pan for 4 minutes per side, pink in the centre, rest for 5 minutes and slice.

Bring 250 ml water to the boil, rain in the maize meal while stirring and cook for 8 minutes into firm ugali. Dice the tomato, red onion and cucumber and mix with the lime juice, coriander and remaining rapeseed oil into a kachumbari.
Serve the sliced grilled beef with the ugali and kachumbari.

title: Kenyan beef pilau with potatoes and kachumbari
instructions: Dice the beef and brown in the rapeseed oil for 6 minutes, then add half of the onion. Dice the potatoes.
Toast the pilau spice briefly, add the parboiled rice and potatoes, pour in 180 ml water and simmer covered for 20 minutes, then rest for 5 minutes.
Dice the remaining red onion and the tomato and mix with the coriander into a kachumbari.
Fluff the pilau and serve with the kachumbari.

title: Chakalaka with grilled tilapia and maize porridge
instructions: Fry the onion, pepper and carrot in 4 g of the rapeseed oil for 5 minutes, add the passata, white beans, curry powder and chilli and simmer for 10 minutes.
Bring 160 ml water to the boil, rain in the maize meal while stirring and cook for 8 minutes into a soft porridge.
Brush the tilapia with 2 g of rapeseed oil and cook in a grill pan for 4 minutes per side until firm and white.
Plate the maize porridge and set the tilapia and chakalaka alongside.

title: Vegetarian bunny chow, bean curry in a wholemeal loaf
instructions: Sweat the onion in the rapeseed oil for 3 minutes and toast the curry powder and cumin briefly. Dice the tofu and fry for 4 minutes.
Add the kidney beans and passata, simmer until creamy for 12 minutes and finish with coriander.
Cut the lid off the wholemeal bread and hollow out the inside, leaving a 1 cm thick shell. Tear the removed bread into pieces.
Spoon the bean and tofu filling into the bread and serve with the lid and the bread pieces.

title: Attiéké with grilled tilapia and onion-tomato relish
instructions: Loosen the attiéké with 2 tbsp hot water and steam it in a sieve for 5 minutes until the grains are hot and fluffy.
Brush the tilapia with 3 g of the rapeseed oil and cook in a grill pan for 4 minutes per side until firm and white.
Finely dice the tomato, red onion, cucumber and chilli and mix with the lime juice and remaining rapeseed oil into a relish.
Make a bed of attiéké, lay the tilapia on top and set the relish alongside.

title: Poulet DG with plantain, peppers and basmati
instructions: Simmer the basmati rice in 60 ml salted water for 12 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Peel the plantain, cut into diagonal slices and fry in 4 g of the rapeseed oil for 4 minutes until golden, then lift out.
Cut the chicken breast into 4 pieces and brown in the remaining rapeseed oil for 5 minutes. Add the pepper, carrot, green beans and onion and fry for 8 minutes.
Return the plantain, toss for 3 minutes and serve with the basmati.

title: Fonio salad with mango, cucumber, tomato and peanuts
instructions: Pour 90 ml boiling water over the fonio, leave to swell covered for 5 minutes, fluff with a fork and leave to cool.
Dice the mango, cucumber and tomato, roughly chop the peanuts, and finely slice the mint and parsley.
Toss the fonio with the olive oil and lime juice, fold in the fruit, vegetables, herbs and peanuts and serve immediately.

title: Fonio breakfast porridge with roasted berries and peanuts
instructions: Bring the low-fat milk to the boil with the cinnamon, stir in the fonio and simmer gently for 8 minutes until creamy, stirring.
Roast the berries in a non-stick pan without fat for 3 minutes until they release juice and lightly caramelise.
Spoon the porridge into a bowl, top with the roasted berries and peanuts and serve warm immediately.

title: Egyptian shorbet ads, lentil soup with lemon, cumin and pita
instructions: Sweat the onion, garlic and carrot in the rapeseed oil for 4 minutes and toast the cumin briefly with them.
Add the lentils and water and simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils break down. Blend the soup smooth and season with pepper.
Split the wholemeal pita into two pockets and toast in a toaster or the oven for 3 minutes.
Finish the soup with the lemon juice and serve with the pita.

title: Poulet moambe with palm nut sauce, rice and spinach
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 70 ml salted water for 12 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Cut the chicken breast into 4 pieces and brown without extra fat for 5 minutes, then add the onion.
Stir the palm nut cream smooth with the passata and 80 ml water, pour it over the chicken and braise until creamy for 15 minutes.
Fold in the spinach, wilt for 3 minutes and serve with coriander and the rice.

title: Kefta tagine with eggs, tomato and wholemeal couscous
instructions: Mix the minced lamb with half of the herbs, the cumin, cinnamon and pepper and shape 8 small kefta meatballs.
Sweat the onion in the rapeseed oil for 3 minutes, pour in the passata, add the kefta and simmer for 15 minutes.
Crack the egg into a well in the sauce and cook covered for 5 minutes until the white is set and the yolk is still soft.
Leave the couscous to swell in 80 ml boiling water for 5 minutes and fluff. Serve the tagine with the remaining herbs and the couscous.

title: Fideuà with prawns, squid and aioli
instructions: Grate 2 g of the 6 g garlic very finely and stir with 3 g of the olive oil into an aioli. Slice the remaining garlic.
Toast the short wholemeal noodles in 5 g of olive oil for 2 minutes until golden. Add the sliced garlic, passata, saffron and paprika, and pour in the water.
Add the prawns and the squid in rings and simmer for 10 minutes until the noodles have absorbed the water and the dish is set like a paella.
Finish with the lemon juice and parsley and serve the aioli alongside.

title: Arroz negro with squid, aioli and lemon
instructions: Grate 2 g of the 6 g garlic very finely and stir with 3 g of the olive oil into an aioli. Finely dice the remaining garlic and the onion.
Cut the squid into rings and fry in 5 g of olive oil for 3 minutes, then add the onion, garlic and pepper strips.
Add the parboiled rice and the squid ink, stir for 1 minute, pour in the water and simmer for 15 minutes, then rest for 5 minutes until the rice is black and creamy.
Serve with the lemon juice and parsley, and offer the aioli alongside.

title: Paella de verduras with artichokes, beans and saffron
instructions: Cut the pepper into strips, dice the tomato, halve the artichoke hearts and cut the green beans into pieces.
Fry the vegetables in the olive oil for 5 minutes, add the parboiled rice, saffron and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the white beans and water and simmer without stirring for 15 minutes until the rice has absorbed the water, then rest for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve straight from the pan.

title: Salmorejo with egg, olive oil and cucumber sticks
instructions: Boil the egg for 9 minutes until hard, cool, peel and quarter it.
Blend the tomato, wholemeal bread, garlic, sherry vinegar and 6 g of the olive oil with a pinch of salt until smooth, and chill for 10 minutes.
Cut the cucumber into sticks.
Pour the cold, creamy soup into a bowl and serve with the egg, the remaining olive oil and the cucumber sticks.

title: Seville-style espinacas con garbanzos with wholemeal bread
instructions: Fry the garlic in the olive oil for 1 minute until golden, toast the cumin and paprika briefly with it, without burning.
Add the chickpeas and toss in the spiced oil for 5 minutes.
Fold in the spinach, wilt for 3 minutes and finish with the lemon juice.
Toast the wholemeal bread and serve it with the pan.

title: Albóndigas in almond sauce with saffron and salad
instructions: Mix the minced turkey with the egg, half of the parsley, salt and pepper and shape 8 small meatballs.
Toast the almonds in 2 g of the olive oil until golden, then blend smooth with the garlic, passata, saffron and 80 ml water.
Brown the meatballs all over in the remaining olive oil for 6 minutes, pour in the almond sauce and simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce is creamy.
Serve with the remaining parsley and the leaf salad.

title: Bacalhau à Brás with egg, potatoes, olives and parsley
instructions: Cut the potatoes into very fine matchsticks and fry in 5 g of the olive oil for 10 minutes until golden and crisp, then lift out.
Flake the pollock into small pieces. Sweat the onion in 3 g of olive oil for 4 minutes until translucent, and cook the pollock with it for 3 minutes.
Return the potato matchsticks, pour over the beaten egg and stir for 1 minute just until barely set, leaving the mixture creamy.
Serve immediately with the olives and parsley.

title: Cataplana de marisco with tomato, pepper and herbs
instructions: Sweat the onion and pepper in the olive oil for 4 minutes, dice the tomato and cook for 3 more minutes.
Pour in the alcohol-free white wine and bring to the boil. Add the mussels, prawns and the squid in rings.
Steam covered for 8 minutes until the prawns are pink and the squid is tender.
Scatter with parsley and coriander and serve hot in a deep bowl.

title: Portuguese duck rice with orange and olives
instructions: Cut the skinless duck breast into 3 pieces and brown in the rapeseed oil for 5 minutes, then lift out, keeping the pan juices.
Sweat the onion in the juices for 3 minutes, add the parboiled rice and cook for 1 minute. Pour in 120 ml water and the juice of half of the orange.
Return the duck, add the olives, simmer covered for 15 minutes and leave to stand for 5 minutes.
Segment the remaining orange, scatter it over the rice with the parsley and serve.

title: Clams à Bulhão Pato, mussels with coriander and lemon
instructions: Slice the garlic and fry in the olive oil for 2 minutes until golden, without letting it brown.
Add the shelled mussels and toss over the heat for 4 minutes until heated through.
Fold in the lemon juice and half of the coriander and take the pan off the heat.
Serve in a deep bowl, scatter with the remaining coriander and offer the wholemeal bread for dipping.

title: Pastel de nata light with cinnamon and orange segments
instructions: Cut the strudel or filo pastry into 2 thin rounds and line two small greased moulds to make thin tart shells, without stacking it in flaky layers.
Whisk the milk, egg and honey until smooth, fill the moulds and bake at 220 °C for 15 minutes until the tops are golden-blotched and the custard is just set.
Segment the orange. Leave the tarts to cool for 10 minutes.
Dust with cinnamon and serve with the orange segments. Do not use icing sugar.

title: Youvarlakia, Greek lemon meatball soup with dill
instructions: Mix the minced turkey with half of the parboiled rice, half of the egg, the onion and salt and shape 8 small meatballs.
Bring the vegetable stock to the boil, add the meatballs and the sliced carrot and poach for 15 minutes. Add the wholemeal orzo and cook for 8 more minutes.
Whisk the remaining egg with the lemon juice until foamy, temper with 2 ladles of hot broth, then stir the mixture into the soup and do not boil again.
Finish with dill and serve in a deep bowl.

title: Beef stifado with shallots, cinnamon and wholemeal orzo
instructions: Cut the beef into 3 cm cubes and brown in the olive oil for 6 minutes, then lift out.
Brown the shallots whole in the pan juices for 4 minutes, add the passata, red wine vinegar, cinnamon, bay leaf and pepper. Return the beef and pour in 150 ml water.
Braise covered for 40 minutes until the beef is tender and the sauce is glossy.
Cook the wholemeal orzo in salted water for 8 minutes until al dente, drain and serve with the stifado.

title: Kleftiko, oven lamb with potatoes, lemon and oregano
instructions: Cut the lamb into 4 pieces and marinate with 5 g of the olive oil, the lemon juice, oregano, garlic, salt and pepper for 10 minutes.
Cut the potatoes into wedges and the onion into large pieces and toss with the remaining olive oil.
Place everything in a dish or a sealed parcel of baking paper and braise at 180 °C for 55 minutes until the lamb is tender.
Open the parcel and serve with the roasting juices.

title: Chicken souvlaki with lemon potatoes and cabbage salad
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into 8 cubes, marinate with 4 g of the olive oil, half of the lemon juice, oregano and garlic and thread onto two skewers.
Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with 3 g of olive oil and the remaining lemon juice and roast at 200 °C for 30 minutes until golden.
Cook the skewers in a grill pan or under the grill for 8 minutes, turning. Shred the white cabbage finely and mix with 1 g of olive oil and the parsley.
Serve the skewers with the lemon potatoes and the cabbage salad.

title: Kakavia, Greek fisherman's soup with potatoes and herbs
instructions: Sweat the onion and fennel in the olive oil for 4 minutes, dice the potatoes and cook for 3 more minutes.
Dice the tomato, add it with the water and simmer for 12 minutes until the potatoes are starting to soften.
Add the sea bass and the cod in 4 pieces and poach in the broth for 8 minutes until the fish is white and firm but not dry.
Finish with the lemon juice and parsley and serve in a deep bowl.

title: Ploughman's lunch with cheddar, apple, pickles and wholemeal bread
instructions: Cut the wholemeal bread into 2 slices. Cut the cheddar into 3 mm slices.
Quarter the apple, core it and cut into wedges. Slice the tomato.
Arrange the bread, cheddar, apple, gherkins, tomato and leaf salad side by side on a plate and serve immediately.

title: Fiskeboller in a light sauce with carrots and potatoes
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cook them in salted water for 20 minutes. Cook the sliced carrot with them for 10 minutes.
Chop or blend the cod very finely, knead with 2 g of the wholemeal flour, salt, pepper and half of the dill into a smooth mixture and shape 6 balls.
Poach the balls in lightly boiling salted water for 8 minutes and lift them out carefully.

Sweat the rapeseed oil and remaining flour for 1 minute, pour in the low-fat milk, simmer until creamy for 3 minutes and finish with lemon juice and the remaining dill. Serve the fiskeboller in the sauce with the potatoes and carrot.

title: Janssons frestelse light with anchovies, potato and herb salad
instructions: Cut the potatoes into thin matchsticks and the onion into rings. Grease a small ovenproof dish with 2 g of the rapeseed oil.
Layer the potatoes, onion and chopped anchovies in the dish and pour over the light cream and 2 tbsp water.
Bake at 200 °C for 30 minutes until the top is golden and the potatoes are soft.
Toss the leaf salad with the dill, parsley and remaining rapeseed oil and serve with the Janssons frestelse.

title: Rakott krumpli with egg, yoghurt and turkey sausage
instructions: Boil the potatoes in their skins for 20 minutes, peel and slice them. Boil the egg for 9 minutes until hard, peel and slice it.
Slice the turkey sausage and cut the onion into rings. Grease a small dish with 2 g of the rapeseed oil.
Layer the potatoes, egg, turkey sausage and onion, stir the yoghurt smooth with the paprika and pepper, pour it over and drizzle with the remaining rapeseed oil.
Bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes until the top is golden.

title: Escalivada with goat's cheese, wholemeal bread and herb oil
instructions: Cut the aubergine, pepper and onion into large wedges, toss with 3 g of the olive oil and roast at 220 °C for 25 minutes until the pepper skin blisters and the vegetables are soft.
Peel the skin from the aubergine and pepper and tear the flesh into long strips.
Stir the remaining olive oil with the lemon juice and the herbs into a herb oil. Toast the wholemeal bread.
Arrange the vegetable strips on a plate, crumble over the goat's cheese, drizzle with the herb oil and serve with the bread.

title: Pollo al ajillo with roasted potatoes and leaf salad
instructions: Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with 3 g of the olive oil and roast at 200 °C for 30 minutes until golden.
Cut the chicken breast into 4 pieces. Slice the garlic and fry in 4 g of olive oil for 1 minute until golden.
Cut the pepper into strips and dice the tomato, and fry with the chicken for 8 minutes. Deglaze with the white wine and lemon juice, reduce for 2 minutes and fold in the parsley.
Toss the leaf salad with 1 g of olive oil and serve with the chicken and the roasted potatoes.

title: Arroz de marisco with mussels, prawns and coriander
instructions: Sweat the onion, garlic and pepper in the olive oil for 3 minutes, dice the tomato and cook for 2 more minutes.
Add the parboiled rice, cook for 1 minute, pour in the water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the mussels and prawns and cook for 6 more minutes until the prawns are pink and the rice has absorbed the water.
Finish with the lemon juice and coriander and serve in a deep bowl.

title: Grilled green asparagus a la plancha with romesco and egg
instructions: Boil the egg for 9 minutes until hard, cool, peel and quarter it.
Toast the almonds in 1 g of the olive oil until golden. Blend the pepper, tomato, garlic, toasted almonds, sherry vinegar and 2 g of olive oil into a thick romesco sauce.
Snap off the woody ends of the asparagus, toss with 2 g of olive oil and cook on a very hot plancha or grill pan for 6 minutes, turning, until tender-crisp and lightly browned.
Serve the asparagus with the romesco and the egg.

title: 15-minute turkey strips with courgette, lemon and couscous
instructions: Leave the couscous to swell in 80 ml boiling water and 1 g of the olive oil for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.
Cut the turkey breast into strips and fry in 3 g of olive oil for 6 minutes until golden, then lift out.
Cut the courgette into half-moons and fry in the remaining olive oil for 4 minutes until tender-crisp, return the turkey and fold in the lemon juice and parsley.
Serve with the couscous immediately.

title: 15-minute prawn and tomato pan with wholemeal spaghetti
instructions: Cook the wholemeal noodles in salted water for 8 minutes until al dente, reserve 2 tbsp of the cooking water and drain.
Sweat the garlic and chilli in the olive oil for 1 minute, dice the tomato and cook for 4 minutes until collapsed.
Add the prawns and fry for 3 minutes until pink, then pour in the noodle water.
Toss with the noodles and parsley and serve immediately.

title: 15-minute tuna and white bean salad with red onion and parsley
instructions: Drain and rinse the white beans. Dice the tomato, cut the red onion into fine rings and roughly chop the parsley.
Flake the tuna with a fork.
Gently toss everything with the olive oil and lemon juice.
Serve in a bowl immediately.

title: 15-minute tempeh ginger bowl with rice and pak choi
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 80 ml salted water for 12 minutes and leave to stand briefly.
Dice the tempeh and fry in 4 g of the sesame oil for 5 minutes until golden. Add the grated ginger and soy sauce and toss until glossy for 1 minute.
Quarter the pak choi and fry in the remaining sesame oil for 3 minutes until the stems are tender-crisp.
Arrange the rice, tempeh and pak choi in a bowl and scatter with spring onion.

title: 15-minute smoked tofu wrap with avocado and salsa
instructions: Cut the smoked tofu into strips and sear in a dry pan for 4 minutes.
Dice the tomato and onion and mix with the coriander and lime juice into a salsa. Slice the avocado.
Warm the wholemeal wrap briefly and fill with the tofu, avocado and salsa.
Roll up tightly and eat immediately, or cut through the middle.

title: 15-minute tuna spaghetti with capers, lemon and olives
instructions: Cook the wholemeal noodles in salted water for 8 minutes until al dente, reserve 2 tbsp of the cooking water and drain.
Warm the capers and olives in the olive oil for 1 minute, add the tuna and flake it.
Toss the noodles with the noodle water and lemon juice and stir for 1 minute.
Scatter with parsley and serve immediately.

title: 15-minute halloumi and orange salad with mint and rocket
instructions: Cut the halloumi into 1 cm slices and fry in 2 g of the olive oil for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Segment the orange, catching the juice. Roughly chop the walnuts and pick the mint leaves.
Toss the rocket with the remaining olive oil and the orange juice and spread it on a plate.
Top with the halloumi, orange segments, walnuts and mint and serve immediately.

title: 15-minute chicken and radicchio salad with hard cheese and yoghurt dressing
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into strips and fry in 2 g of the olive oil for 6 minutes until golden, season with pepper and herbes de Provence and rest briefly.
Stir the yoghurt with the lemon juice and remaining olive oil into a dressing, without added salt.
Tear the radicchio and leaf salad and quarter the tomato.
Toss the salad with the dressing, top with the chicken, finely grate the hard cheese over it and serve immediately.

title: 15-minute soba salad with edamame, cucumber and sesame dressing
instructions: Cook the soba noodles for 5 minutes, rinse under cold water and drain. Blanch the edamame in salted water for 3 minutes and drain.
Cut the cucumber into half-moons, the carrot into fine matchsticks and the spring onion into rings.
Stir the soy sauce, sesame oil, lime juice and chilli into a dressing.
Toss the noodles, edamame, cucumber and carrot with the dressing and serve with sesame seeds and spring onion.

title: 15-minute chickpea and tomato pan with spinach and feta
instructions: Sweat the garlic in the olive oil for 1 minute, dice the tomato and cook for 4 minutes until collapsed.
Add the chickpeas and toss over the heat for 4 minutes, and finish with lemon juice, oregano and parsley.
Fold in the spinach and wilt for 2 minutes.
Serve in a bowl, crumble the feta over it and serve immediately.

title: 15-minute skyr bowl with granola, berries and peanut butter
instructions: Toast the oats in a non-stick pan without fat for 4 minutes, turning, until they smell like granola and are golden.
Spoon the skyr into a bowl and spread it smooth.
Arrange the berries and toasted oats on top, add the peanut butter in small dots and serve immediately.

title: 15-minute tostadas with beans, egg and pico de gallo
instructions: Fry the corn tortillas in 2 g of the rapeseed oil for 1 minute per side until crisp and firm as tostadas.
Roughly mash the black beans with a fork and heat them in the same pan for 3 minutes. Fry the egg in 2 g of rapeseed oil as a fried egg.
Dice the tomato and onion and mix with the coriander and lime juice into a pico de gallo.
Top the tostadas with the beans, fried egg and pico and serve immediately while crisp.

title: 15-minute courgette pasta with prawns, chilli and lemon
instructions: Cut the courgette into long, noodle-like strips with a spiraliser or a peeler.
Sweat the garlic and chilli in the olive oil for 1 minute, add the prawns and fry for 3 minutes until pink.
Add the courgette strips and cook for 2 minutes so they just wilt, remaining tender-crisp.
Finish with the lemon juice and parsley and serve immediately.

title: 15-minute turkey and pepper pan with brown rice
instructions: Simmer the brown rice in 120 ml salted water for 25 minutes and leave to stand covered.
Cut the turkey breast into strips, the pepper into wedges and the onion into rings, and finely chop the garlic.
Fry the turkey in the rapeseed oil for 5 minutes until golden, add the vegetables and garlic and fry together for 6 minutes until tender-crisp.
Deglaze with the lemon juice, fold in the parsley and serve immediately with the brown rice.

title: 15-minute sardine toast with fennel, orange and capers
instructions: Toast the wholemeal toast until golden. Slice the fennel very thinly and cut the orange into segments.
Roughly mash the sardines and mix with 4 g of the olive oil, the capers and half of the dill.
Spread the sardine mixture on the toast and top with the fennel and orange segments.
Drizzle with the remaining olive oil and dill and eat immediately.

title: 15-minute egg fried rice with vegetables and sesame
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 100 ml salted water for 12 minutes and leave to stand briefly.
Cut the carrot into fine matchsticks and the spring onion into rings. Beat the eggs.
Heat the rapeseed oil in a hot pan, set the eggs for 1 minute and lift out. Fry the carrot, peas and half of the spring onion in the sesame oil for 3 minutes.
Add the rice and soy sauce, fry for 2 minutes, fold in the eggs and serve with the sesame and remaining spring onion.

title: 15-minute melon and turkey salad with mint and lime
instructions: Cut the turkey breast into thin strips and fry in 4 g of the olive oil for 5 minutes until golden, then lift out of the pan.
Deseed the melon and cut it into bite-sized cubes, and wash the lamb's lettuce.
Stir the lime juice with the remaining olive oil into a dressing.
Arrange the lamb's lettuce, melon, turkey and mint, spoon over the dressing and serve immediately.

title: 15-minute miso soup with tofu, wakame and spring onion greens
instructions: Soak the wakame in a little cold water for 5 minutes and drain. Cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes.
Heat the vegetable stock and warm the tofu in it for 4 minutes.
Take the pot off the heat, stir the miso smooth in a ladle of the broth and add it to the soup, then do not boil again.
Add the wakame and spring onion greens, drizzle with the sesame oil and serve immediately.

title: 15-minute cottage cheese toast with tomato, basil and balsamic
instructions: Toast the wholemeal toast until golden.
Slice the tomato and roughly tear the basil.
Spread the toast with the cottage cheese and top with the tomato.
Top with the basil, drizzle over the balsamic and eat immediately.

title: 15-minute lentil salad jar with feta, cucumber and capers
instructions: Simmer the lentils in salted water for 15 minutes until soft, drain and cool under cold water.
Dice the cucumber and tomato, slice the red onion into thin rings and chop the parsley.
Stir the olive oil and lemon juice into a dressing and fold it into the lentils, vegetables and parsley.
Layer into a jar, add the feta and capers on top and serve cold or freshly made.

title: 15-minute wok pak choi with chicken and cashews
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into strips, the pak choi into long quarters, the pepper into wedges and the carrot into diagonal slices. Finely grate the garlic and ginger.
Fry the chicken in the sesame oil for 5 minutes until golden, then lift out.
Wok the pak choi, pepper, carrot, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes until tender-crisp, add the chicken and soy sauce and toss for 2 minutes.
Scatter over the cashews and serve immediately, hot.

title: 15-minute protein wrap with hummus, turkey, carrot and rocket
instructions: Cut the turkey breast into thin strips and fry in a non-stick pan without extra fat for 6 minutes until golden.
Shave or grate the carrot into fine strips and wash the rocket.
Warm the wholemeal wrap until just lukewarm and spread it evenly with the hummus.
Fill with the turkey, carrot and rocket, roll up tightly and serve the diagonal halves immediately.

title: 15-minute trout fillet with cucumber and fennel salad
instructions: Pat the trout dry and season with salt and pepper. Fry in 4 g of the olive oil for 3 minutes per side until the flesh is matte and just cooked.
Slice the cucumber and fennel very thinly and chop the dill.
Stir the remaining olive oil with the lemon juice into a dressing and spoon it over the salad.
Place the trout on the cucumber-fennel salad, scatter with dill and serve immediately.

title: 15-minute couscous salad with grilled vegetables and lemon-mint dressing
instructions: Leave the couscous to swell in 80 ml boiling water for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.
Slice the courgette, pepper and aubergine and fry in 6 g of the olive oil in a grill pan for 6 minutes until the edges are charred.
Fold the chickpeas into the couscous and stir the lemon juice, remaining olive oil and chopped mint into a dressing.
Place the grilled vegetables on the couscous, spoon over the dressing and serve lukewarm.

title: 15-minute halloumi and vegetable wrap with mint yoghurt
instructions: Cut the halloumi into 4 slices and fry in 4 g of the olive oil for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Cut the courgette and pepper into strips and fry in the remaining olive oil for 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Cut the cucumber into sticks.
Stir the yoghurt with the chopped mint. Warm the wholemeal wrap until just lukewarm.
Fill the wrap with the mint yoghurt, vegetables, cucumber and halloumi, roll it up and serve immediately.

title: Air fryer chicken tenders with pepper dip and coleslaw
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into long strips, toss with 3 g of the rapeseed oil, the paprika, salt and pepper and coat in the chickpea flour.
Cook in the air fryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes, turning once, until the tenders are golden and cooked through.
Dice a third of the pepper, roughly purée the rest and stir with 20 g of the yoghurt into a dip.
Shred the white cabbage finely and mix with the remaining yoghurt, lemon juice and remaining rapeseed oil into a coleslaw. Serve with the tenders and the dip.

title: Air fryer trout with a hazelnut crust and celery
instructions: Roughly chop the hazelnuts and mix with 3 g of the olive oil, half of the parsley, salt and pepper.
Pat the trout dry and press the crust firmly onto the top. Cook in the air fryer at 180 °C for 10 minutes until the flesh is just cooked and the nuts are golden.
Cut the celery into diagonal pieces and sweat in the remaining olive oil for 4 minutes until tender-crisp, then finish with the lemon juice.
Serve the trout on the celery and scatter with the remaining parsley.

title: Air fryer tempeh nuggets with mustard-maple dip and coleslaw
instructions: Cut the tempeh into 8 nuggets, toss with 5 g of the mustard and 3 g of the rapeseed oil and coat in the chickpea flour.
Cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for 12 minutes until golden and crisp, turning once.
Stir the remaining mustard with the maple syrup into a dip.
Shred the white cabbage and carrot finely, toss with the remaining rapeseed oil and serve with the nuggets and the dip.

title: Air fryer romanesco with tahini-lime and pomegranate
instructions: Divide the romanesco into medium florets, pre-steam with 2 tbsp water in the air-fryer drawer for 2 minutes, then drain.
Roast in the air fryer at 190 °C for 12 minutes until the florets are browned at the edges and tender-crisp inside.
Stir the tahini with the lime juice and 1 tbsp water until smooth.
Arrange the romanesco on a plate, drizzle over the tahini-lime and scatter with the pomegranate seeds and parsley.

title: Air fryer beetroot falafel with tahini, rocket and pomegranate
instructions: Roughly blend the chickpeas, beetroot, chickpea flour, hemp seeds, cumin, pepper and 2 g of the olive oil and shape 6 flat falafel.
Bake in the air fryer at 190 °C for 14 minutes, turning once, until the edges are firm and lightly roasted.
Stir the tahini with 1 tbsp water until smooth.
Arrange the falafel on the rocket, drizzle with the tahini, scatter over the pomegranate seeds and serve with the remaining olive oil.

title: Air fryer cod patties with pea dip and salad
instructions: Chop the cod very finely, knead with the egg, oats, finely chopped onion, half of the dill, salt and pepper and shape 4 flat patties.
Brush with 3 g of the olive oil and cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for 12 minutes until golden, turning once.
Cook the peas for 4 minutes, roughly mash and stir with the yoghurt, lemon juice and remaining dill into a dip.
Dress the salad with the remaining olive oil and serve with the patties and the dip.

title: Air fryer green bean fries with herb yoghurt
instructions: Trim the green beans and toss with the olive oil, salt and pepper. Roughly chop the almonds.
Roast the beans in the air fryer at 200 °C for 10 minutes, adding the almonds after 6 minutes, until the beans are slightly wrinkled and the almonds are golden.
Stir the yoghurt with the chopped parsley, chives and lemon juice into a herb yoghurt.
Serve the bean fries immediately with the dip.

title: Air fryer herb-crusted cod with pea purée
instructions: Finely chop the almonds and parsley and mix with 4 g of the olive oil, salt and pepper into a herb crust.
Pat the cod dry and press the crust firmly onto the top. Cook in the air fryer at 180 °C for 12 minutes until the fish is just white and the crust is golden.
Cook the peas for 6 minutes and roughly purée with the remaining olive oil and half of the lemon juice.
Serve the cod on the pea purée and drizzle with the remaining lemon juice.

title: Air fryer sweet potato tacos with black beans and avocado-lime cream
instructions: Cut the sweet potato into 1 cm wedges and cook in the air fryer at 200 °C for 16 minutes until soft and roasted at the edges.
Heat the black beans for 3 minutes. Roughly mash the avocado with the lime juice into a cream.
Warm the corn tortillas in the air fryer for 1 minute only, without baking them crisp.
Fill the tortillas with the beans, sweet potato and avocado cream, scatter with coriander and serve immediately.

title: Air fryer chicken thighs with harissa and couscous salad
instructions: Rub the skinless chicken thighs with the harissa, 4 g of the olive oil, salt and pepper. Cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for 22 minutes until the meat is cooked through and the surface is roasted.
Leave the wholemeal couscous to swell in 80 ml boiling water for 8 minutes and fluff.
Dice the cucumber and tomato and fold them into the couscous with the lemon juice, remaining olive oil and parsley.
Serve the chicken with the couscous salad and drizzle with the juices from the drawer.

title: Air fryer squid rings with lemon yoghurt and salad
instructions: Pat the squid rings dry and toss with 4 g of the olive oil, salt and pepper. Cook in the air fryer at 200 °C for 8 minutes, shaking once, until the edges are lightly golden and the flesh is just tender, not rubbery.
Stir the yoghurt with 8 g of the lemon juice and half of the parsley into a dip.
Dress the salad with the remaining olive oil and remaining lemon juice.
Arrange the squid rings with the dip and salad and scatter over the remaining parsley. The rings are unbreaded.

title: Air fryer tempeh skewers with peanut sauce and cucumber salad
instructions: Cut the tempeh into 8 cubes, marinate with the soy sauce, 4 g of the lime juice and the rapeseed oil for 5 minutes and thread onto 2 skewers.
Cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for 12 minutes, turning once, until the edges are deep gold.
Stir the peanut butter with the remaining lime juice and 1 tbsp hot water into a sauce. Slice the cucumber and cut the spring onion into rings.
Serve the skewers on the cucumber salad and spoon over the sauce and spring onion.

title: Air fryer lamb köfte with mint yoghurt and tomato-pepper salad
instructions: Knead the lamb mince with the fine bulgur, half of the onion, the finely chopped garlic, half of the mint, salt and pepper and shape 6 small köfte.
Brush with 3 g of the olive oil and cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for 12 minutes, turning once, until brown and cooked through.
Stir the yoghurt with the remaining mint. Dice the tomato and pepper, slice the remaining onion into thin rings and mix with the lemon juice and remaining olive oil.
Serve the köfte with the mint yoghurt and tomato-pepper salad.

title: Air fryer cauliflower cheese tots with skyr dip
instructions: Steam the cauliflower florets for 6 minutes, squeeze dry and chop finely. Knead with the oats, egg, grated light mozzarella, salt and pepper and shape 10 small tots.
Lightly grease the air-fryer drawer with the rapeseed oil. Bake the tots at 200 °C for 14 minutes until golden, turning once.
Stir the skyr with the chives into a dip.
Serve the tots immediately, hot, with the skyr dip.

title: Air fryer wholemeal pita chips with aubergine-tahini cream, pomegranate and cucumber sticks
instructions: Halve the aubergine lengthways, rub with 4 g of the olive oil and cook in the air fryer at 200 °C for 15 minutes until the flesh is very soft.
Scoop out the flesh and blend with the tahini, garlic, lemon juice, 3 g of the olive oil and half of the parsley into a cream.
Cut the wholemeal pita into triangles, brush with the remaining olive oil and bake in the air fryer at 180 °C for 6 minutes until crisp.
Serve the pita chips with the aubergine cream, scatter with the pomegranate seeds and remaining parsley, and serve the cucumber sticks alongside.

title: Air fryer egg bites with spinach, pepper and feta
instructions: Wilt the spinach in a non-stick pan without fat for 2 minutes and squeeze dry. Dice the pepper finely and crumble the feta.
Beat the eggs and fold in the spinach, pepper, feta, salt and pepper. Fill the mixture into 4 small ovenproof moulds.
Bake in the air fryer at 170 °C for 12 minutes until the bites are set and lightly golden on top.
Leave to cool briefly and serve warm as breakfast.

title: Air fryer pear with almond crumble and yoghurt
instructions: Halve the pear and remove the core.
Roughly chop the almonds and oats, mix with the cinnamon and spread on the cut surfaces.
Bake in the air fryer at 180 °C for 12 minutes until the pear is soft and the crumble is golden.
Serve immediately, warm, with the yoghurt.

title: Air fryer granola with nuts and berry yoghurt
instructions: Mix the oats, roughly chopped walnuts and almonds with the rapeseed oil and cinnamon.
Roast in the air fryer at 160 °C for 10 minutes until golden, shaking after 5 minutes so nothing burns.
Leave to cool briefly until the granola turns crisp.
Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl, arrange the berries and granola on top and eat immediately.

title: Air fryer okra with tomato-onion salad and yoghurt
instructions: Pat the okra dry, toss with 4 g of the olive oil, salt and pepper. Roast in the air fryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes until the tips are lightly crisp and the pods are not slimy.
Dice the tomato, slice the red onion into thin rings and mix with the lemon juice, remaining olive oil and parsley.
Stir the yoghurt until smooth.
Serve the okra with the tomato-onion salad and the yoghurt.

title: Air fryer pollock burger in a wholemeal bun with pea-mint mash
instructions: Pat the pollock dry and rub with 3 g of the olive oil, salt and pepper. Cook in the air fryer at 190 °C for 10 minutes until the fish is just white and flakes in large pieces.
Cook the peas for 5 minutes and roughly mash with the mint, remaining olive oil and 4 g of the lemon juice into a purée.
Split the wholemeal bun and toast it in the air fryer for 2 minutes. Drizzle the salad with the remaining lemon juice.
Fill the bun with the salad, pollock and pea-mint mash and serve immediately.

title: Air fryer celeriac fries with harissa yoghurt
instructions: Peel the celeriac and cut it into 1 cm fries, toss with the olive oil, salt and pepper.
Cook in the air fryer at 200 °C for 18 minutes, shaking twice, until the edges are golden and the fries are soft inside.
Stir the yoghurt with the harissa and lemon juice into a dip.
Serve the fries immediately, hot, with the dip.

title: Air fryer mushroom caps with a herb quark filling
instructions: Remove the mushroom stalks and pat the caps dry. Chop the stalks finely.
Stir the quark with the stalks, parsley, chives, salt and pepper into a filling and spoon it into the caps.
Drizzle with the olive oil and cook in the air fryer at 180 °C for 10 minutes until the caps release juice and the filling sets.
Serve immediately, warm, as a snack.

title: Air fryer gochujang chicken bowl with rice, cucumber and kimchi
instructions: Simmer the parboiled rice in 90 ml salted water for 12 minutes and leave to stand.

Cut the chicken breast into cubes, marinate with the gochujang and 3 g of the sesame oil. Cook in the air fryer at 200 °C for 12 minutes, turning once, until the edges are caramelised and the meat is cooked through.
Slice the cucumber and cut the spring onion into rings.
Arrange the rice in a bowl, top with the chicken, cucumber and kimchi, and serve with the remaining sesame oil and spring onion.

title: Air fryer apple rings with cinnamon and a quark dip
instructions: Core the apple and cut it into 1 cm rings, then dust with cinnamon.
Cook in the air fryer at 180 °C for 10 minutes, turning once, until the rings are soft and lightly golden at the edges but still hold their shape.
Roughly chop the almonds and scatter them over the rings for the last 3 minutes until fragrant.
Stir the quark smooth and serve it as a dip with the warm apple rings.

title: Air fryer tortilla pizza with turkey, pepper and mozzarella
instructions: Cut the turkey breast into thin strips and pre-fry in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes. Slice the pepper into rings.
Spread the corn tortilla with the passata, then top with the turkey, pepper and torn light mozzarella.
Bake in the air fryer at 200 °C for 8 minutes until the edge is firm and the cheese has melted.
Scatter with basil, cut into quarters and serve immediately.

title: Air fryer chicken breast with carrots, potatoes, spinach and herb oil
instructions: Cut the potatoes and carrots into even 2 cm pieces, toss with 5 g of the olive oil, salt and pepper. Pre-cook in the air fryer at 200 °C for 10 minutes.

Pat the chicken breast dry, rub with 3 g of the olive oil and add it to the vegetables in the air fryer. Cook for a further 14 minutes until the meat is cooked through and the vegetables are soft and roasted.
Stir the remaining olive oil with the lemon juice, parsley and rosemary into a herb oil. Do not use onion or garlic.
Wilt the leaf spinach without extra fat for 1 minute only. Serve the chicken with the potatoes, carrots and spinach and drizzle with the herb oil.

title: Meal-prep buddha bowl with lentils, beetroot, avocado and tahini
instructions: Simmer the lentils in salted water for 20 minutes until soft, then drain and leave to cool.
Dice the beetroot, slice the avocado and wash the leaf salad.
Stir the tahini with the lime juice and 1 tbsp water until smooth.
Arrange the salad, lentils, beetroot and avocado in a bowl or meal-prep box, drizzle over the tahini and scatter with the pumpkin seeds.

title: Meal-prep gochujang turkey box with pak choi and brown rice
instructions: Simmer the brown rice in 120 ml salted water for 25 minutes and leave to stand covered.
Cut the turkey breast into strips, marinate with the gochujang, ginger and 3 g of the sesame oil and fry in a pan for 6 minutes until the edges are caramelised.
Quarter the pak choi and fry in the remaining sesame oil for 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Cut the spring onion into rings.
Arrange the rice, turkey and pak choi in a box, scatter with spring onion, and eat cold or reheated.

title: Meal-prep mackerel and quinoa box with edamame and sesame dressing
instructions: Simmer the quinoa in 100 ml salted water for 15 minutes, leave to stand covered and then fluff.
Fry the mackerel in a non-stick pan for 3 minutes per side until the flesh is matte and just cooked, then cut into pieces.
Cook the edamame for 4 minutes. Stir the sesame oil, lime juice and soy sauce into a dressing.
Arrange the quinoa, mackerel and edamame in a box and spoon over the dressing and sesame.

title: Meal-prep tofu curry with cauliflower and brown rice
instructions: Simmer the brown rice in 110 ml salted water for 25 minutes and leave to stand.
Cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes and fry in the rapeseed oil for 6 minutes until golden, then lift out.
Divide the cauliflower into florets, sweat with the curry paste for 2 minutes, pour in the light coconut milk and 80 ml water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Warm the tofu in the sauce for 3 minutes and arrange with the brown rice in a box.

title: Meal-prep turkey mince sauce with courgette and wholemeal pasta
instructions: Cook the wholemeal pasta in salted water for 9 minutes until al dente, then drain.
Dice the onion and sweat in the olive oil for 3 minutes, add the turkey mince and fry for 6 minutes until crumbly.
Dice the courgette small, simmer with the passata for 8 minutes and season with salt, pepper and basil.
Arrange the sauce with the pasta in a box and eat cold or reheated.

title: Meal-prep chickpea harissa box with couscous and cucumber-mint salad
instructions: Leave the couscous to swell in 70 ml boiling water for 5 minutes and fluff.
Roast the chickpeas with the harissa and 4 g of the olive oil in a pan for 5 minutes until fragrant.
Dice the cucumber and mix with the mint, lemon juice and remaining olive oil into a salad.
Arrange the couscous, chickpeas and cucumber-mint salad in a box.

title: Poke bowl with tuna, avocado, edamame and nori
instructions: Simmer the sushi rice in 70 ml water for 12 minutes, leave to stand covered for 10 minutes, then leave to cool.
Cut the tuna steak into 2 cm cubes and briefly marinate with 6 g of the soy sauce. Slice the avocado and radishes. Cook the edamame for 4 minutes.
Cut the nori into fine strips.

Arrange the rice in a bowl, top with the tuna, avocado, edamame, radishes and nori, and serve with the remaining soy sauce and sesame. Leave the tuna pink inside if it is very fresh, otherwise cook it through.

title: Freekeh bowl with roasted carrots, chickpeas and herb yoghurt
instructions: Simmer the freekeh in 150 ml salted water for 20 minutes and leave to stand.
Cut the carrots into long wedges, toss with 4 g of the olive oil and roast in the oven at 200 °C for 20 minutes, adding the chickpeas after 10 minutes.
Stir the yoghurt with the parsley, lemon juice and remaining olive oil.
Arrange the freekeh in a bowl, top with the carrots and chickpeas and spoon over the herb yoghurt.

title: Meal-prep spelt jars with tomato, cucumber, feta and olives
instructions: Simmer the spelt in 200 ml salted water for 30 minutes until soft, then drain and cool.
Dice the tomato and cucumber, halve the olives and crumble the feta.
Stir the olive oil, lemon juice and oregano into a dressing and fold it into the spelt.
Layer into jars: spelt, vegetables, olives and feta. Eat cold.

title: Cottage cheese and salmon bowl with beetroot, horseradish and wholemeal toast
instructions: Fry the salmon fillet in a non-stick pan for 4 minutes per side until just cooked, then cut into pieces.
Dice the beetroot. Toast the wholemeal toast until golden.
Stir the cottage cheese with the horseradish and half of the dill.
Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl, top with the salmon, beetroot and remaining dill, and serve with the toast.

title: Soba bowl with smoked trout, radishes and horseradish yoghurt
instructions: Cook the soba noodles in salted water for 5 minutes, rinse under cold water and drain.
Tear the smoked trout into pieces, slice the radishes and cucumber thinly and cut the spring onion into rings.
Stir the yoghurt with the horseradish until smooth.
Arrange the soba in a bowl, top with the trout, radishes, cucumber and spring onion, and add the horseradish yoghurt.

title: Burrito bowl with turkey chilli, corn, salsa and yoghurt
instructions: Fry the turkey mince in a pan for 6 minutes until crumbly, then add the cumin and paprika.
Dice half of the pepper, add the kidney beans, corn and pepper and simmer with the mince for 8 minutes.
Dice the tomato and remaining pepper and mix into a salsa.
Spoon the chilli into a bowl, top with the salsa and yoghurt and serve immediately.

title: Grilled chicken on rocket with pomegranate, mint and pine nuts
instructions: Flatten the chicken breast and grill it in 4 g of the olive oil in a grill pan for 5 minutes per side until cooked through with grill marks. Cut into strips.
Slice the cucumber, tear the mint. Toast the pine nuts in a pan without fat for 2 minutes until golden.
